k:虜.mnemonic: A man (男) caught by the enemy and made to wear tiger stripes (虍): the striped suit of a cartoon prisoner, with bars on every side. Captive (barbarian).
k:虜.hint: A man in a striped suit.

k:妄.mnemonic: A woman (女) is certain her deceased (亡) cat still sits on her lap. She strokes the empty air and talks to it all evening. Delusion (unnecessarily, without authority, reckless).
k:妄.hint: Stroking a cat that isn't there.

k:塊.mnemonic: A farmer's spade turns up something pale and round in the soil (土). A ghost (鬼)! No, only a big lump of earth stuck together. Clod (lump, chunk, clot).
k:塊.hint: A pale lump on the spade.

k:鍛.mnemonic: A smith hammers glowing gold (金) into a weapon (殳), blow after blow, heating and beating until the blade is tough enough for battle. Forge (discipline, train).

k:錯.mnemonic: Twenty (廾) gold (金) coins tossed into the air on a bright day (日): they flash and scatter, and you cannot tell which is which or count them. Confused (mix, be in disorder).

k:妥.mnemonic: A claw (爪) hovers over a woman (女), but she calmly strokes it until the beast purrs and settles down beside her. Gentle (peace, satisfactory, appropriate).

k:詠.mnemonic: Words you say (言) that are meant to last an eternity (永): a poem spoken slowly aloud, each line drawn out long. Recitation (poem, song, composing).

k:詣.mnemonic: You climb the steps and say (言) your prayer at the altar, then buy the delicious (旨) dumplings sold at the gate. Both belong to the trip. Visit a temple (arrive, attain, come).

k:咽.mnemonic: A big (大) bite has to be swallowed several times (回) before it squeezes down the narrow tube behind your tongue. Gullet (throat, choked, smothered).
k:咽.hint: A bite too large to swallow.

k:賄.mnemonic: Shellfish (貝) were once money. The official asks quietly, 'Do you have (有) any?' and a few shells slide across his desk. Bribe (board, supply, finance).

k:繊.mnemonic: A halberd (戈) blade splits a red (赤) thread (糸) lengthwise, again and again, until each strand is almost too thin to see. Slender (fine, thin kimono).

k:匿.mnemonic: A history (史) book the censors want burned is laid in a crate (匚) and covered over with flowers (艹). Nobody thinks to look underneath. Shelter (hide, shield).

k:棺.mnemonic: A box cut from a tree (木), built to the exact measurements of a bureaucrat (官) who filed the form for it in advance. His last office. Coffin (casket).

k:侮.mnemonic: A leader (亻) who sneers at every (毎) single person brought before him, looking down his nose each time. Scorn (despise, make light of, contempt).

k:串.mnemonic: A stick (｜) run through two chunks of grilled chicken, each just the right size for a mouth (口). Skewer (spit).

k:芋.mnemonic: Flowers (艹) above the ground, and below them something fat that you dig up and leave to dry (干) in the sun before storing it for winter. Taro (yam, tuber).

k:謹.mnemonic: Before you say (言) a word at the ceremony you spit (吐) out your gum, then stand holding your flowers (艹) with head bowed. Discreet (reverently, humbly).

k:賜.mnemonic: On a feast day (日) the lord hands out shellfish (貝) money tied with streamers (勿) to everyone who has served him well. Grant (gift, boon, results).

k:茎.mnemonic: Flowers (艹) at the top, soil (土) at the bottom, and also (又) the green part that joins the two and holds the bloom up. Stalk (stem).

k:飢.mnemonic: You sit down to eat (食), but the table (几) is completely bare. Your stomach growls at the empty wood. Hungry (starve).

k:騰.mnemonic: A person (人) trains a horse (馬) for a month (月) until it jumps so high that it seems to clear the clouds and reach heaven (天). Leaping up (jumping up, rising, advancing).

k:麓.mnemonic: Deer (鹿) graze beneath the last tree (木) of the forest, where flat ground meets the first slope. They stay down at the bottom, never on the peak. Foot of a mountain.

k:玩.mnemonic: The origin (元) of every king (王): a small boy on the floor, marching wooden soldiers about. His first kingdom was a plaything. Toy (play, take pleasure in, trifle with).

k:俸.mnemonic: The leader (亻) rewards faithful observance (奉) of duty: the same envelope of pay arrives each month for those who serve him. Stipend (salary).

k:蔑.mnemonic: A net (罒) lies forgotten in the overgrown (茂) garden. Nobody has given it, or the weeds swallowing it, a single glance in years. Ignore (despise, neglect, ridicule).

k:迅.mnemonic: A fish feels the fishhook (乙) and bolts down the path (辶) of the stream ten (十) times faster than the angler can reel. Swift (fast).

k:憧.mnemonic: A juvenile (童) presses his nose to the glass watching his hero play, heartbeat (忄) pounding: one day that will be me. Yearn after (long for, aspire to, admire).

k:抄.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) pick just a few (少) pages out of a thick book, the best bits, and copy those out. Selection (extract, summary, copy).

k:炊.mnemonic: You lack (欠) dinner, so you light a fire (火), set the rice pot on it and wait for the lid to rattle. Cook (boil).

k:煩.mnemonic: You left shellfish (貝) on the fire (火) and cannot find the recipe page (頁). Burning? Still raw? Your head fills with small nagging worries. Anxiety (trouble, worry, pain).
